CodeBehindForm
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Compare Database

Private Sub Form_AfterInsert()
Dim trs As DAO.Recordset, otetopes As DAO.Recordset
Set trs = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset("Списки_агрегатов")
Set otetopes = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset("ОПЭС-ОТЭТ")
otetopes.FindFirst "ОТЭТ=" & Me!stcode
msg = InputBox("Введите установленную мощность")
NUST = msg
For i = 0 To Me.Controls.Count - 1
If Me.Controls(i).Tag = "y" Then
If CDbl(Me.Controls(i).Name) >= CDbl(Me!year) Then Me.Controls(i) = NUST
Me!stcodeopes = otetopes("ОПЭС")
End If
Next i
If ur = 1 Then
trs.AddNew
For i = 0 To Me.Controls.Count - 1
trs(Controls(i).Name) = Controls(i)
trs("ur") = 2
Next i
trs.Update
End If
'DoCmd.RunSQL (CurrentDb.QueryDefs("код_ОПЭС_в_списки").SQL)
End Sub


Private Sub Form_BeforeInsert(Cancel As Integer)
Dim NUST As Double
With Forms("Редактирование").Form!wform.Form
grcode = !numb1120
If IsNull(!MAIN) Then stcode = grcode Else stcode = !MAIN
ur = 1
End With
End Sub

Private Sub year_AfterUpdate()
Dim tform As Form
'Set tform = Me.Parent
For i = 0 To Controls.Count - 1
If Controls(i).Tag = "y" And Controls(i) > 0 Then
GoTo nfound
End If
Next i
nfound:
NUST = Controls(i)
For i = 0 To Controls.Count - 1
If Controls(i).Tag = "y" Then
If CDbl(Controls(i).Name) >= CDbl(year) Then Controls(i) = NUST Else Controls(i) = Null
End If
Next i

End Sub
